name: 5,6-MDO-MiPT
summary: 5,6-MDO-MiPT, or 5,6-methylenedioxy-N-methyl-N-isopropyltryptamine, is a lesser-known chemical compound of the tryptamine family. It is the 5,6-methylenedioxy derivative of methylisopropyltryptamine (MiPT) and an analogue of 5-MeO-MiPT. In his 1991 book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved), Alexander Shulgin lists the dose range as greater than 50 mg orally and its duration as unknown.
summaryZh: 5,6-MDO-MiPT是一種色胺衍生物，化學式為C15H20N2O2，由亞歷山大·舒爾金開發，屬於甲基異丙基色胺的衍生物，可作為迷幻藥物。
summaryZhHans: 5,6-MDO-MiPT是一种色胺衍生物，化学式为C15H20N2O2，由亚历山大·舒尔金开发，属于甲基异丙基色胺的衍生物，可作为迷幻药物。

uses.en: It is a little-known research compound described in Shulgin's work.
uses.zh: 它是Shulgin著作中描述的一種鮮為人知的研究用化合物。
uses.zhHans: 它是Shulgin著作中描述的一种鲜为人知的研究用化合物。

fact.en: It is one of several compounds Shulgin listed in TiHKAL without full accounts of their effects, where the methylenedioxy ring of MDMA has been grafted onto a tryptamine.
fact.zh: 它是Shulgin在《TiHKAL》中列出、但沒有完整作用紀錄的化合物之一，結構上相當於把MDMA的亞甲二氧基環接到色胺骨架上。
fact.zhHans: 它是Shulgin在《TiHKAL》中列出、但没有完整作用纪录的化合物之一，结构上相当于把MDMA的亚甲二氧基环接到色胺骨架上。
